rachel_sdr: Heads up team 1 Ellie (MeridianRetail) wants a POC: multi-tenant ingest -> streaming responses that include function/tool calls returning strict JSON. They asked for: security questionnaire answers, rough pricing for a 3-month pilot (peak ~50 rps, avg ~10 rps, ~5M tokens/day), and an SDK example demonstrating streaming + function calls + structured output. Any immediate blockers?
ellie_cust: Also need SAML SSO and a KMS plan. Can you produce a short runbook for our infra folks?
devendra_se: Quick take: Hosted API is fastest to spin up. If they insist on tenant isolation or strict SLA, Dedicated or Private. For token volume, I'll sketch two pricing paths (hosted pilot blended rate vs Dedicated commit).
devendra_se: POC checklist: 1) sample request/response payloads incl. function schema; 2) SAML IdP metadata; 3) KMS key alias or BYOK plan; 4) latency SLO (p95 target); 5) data residency/regulatory constraints.
marta_prod: Security summary to use in replies: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, option for customer-provided KMS (Private), audit logs with configurable retention, annual pentest summary available. I'll drop the Q&A doc into the thread link.
security_bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sq/meridian-1716123456 (sales+security access only) :lock:
ben_infra: Notes for streaming & function calls: prefer WebSocket/SSE with ephemeral creds. Recommend issuing ephemeral tokens with TTL ~1h for POC and rotate on reconnect. Backpressure: client should apply rate caps; server applies continuous batching. If they need low-jitter latency, Dedicated reserved slots are the right option.
devendra_se: SDK snippet (python) to hand them (streaming + function call loop):```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
with client.stream(model="redwood-chat-1") as s:
    s.send({"input":"List pending refunds for tenant_id=42","functions":[{"name":"get_refunds","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tenant_id":{"type":"integer"}}}}]})
    for event in s.recv():
        if event.type == 'function_call':
            result = get_refunds(event.args)
            s.send({"function_response": result})
        elif event.type == 'chunk':
            print(event.text, end='')
```
devendra_se: Call out structured output flag: set structured_output=True and provide a JSON schema to validate responses. We also run a tiny test harness to assert schema conformance before handing results to the client.
ellie_cust: Show me the websocket handshake + ephemeral token flow so our infra can rotate creds automatically.
ben_infra: Handshake example (auth bridge -> connect):```bash
# get ephemeral token from auth bridge
curl -X POST https://auth.meridian.example/get-ephemeral -d '{"service":"meridian-poc"}' | jq -r .token
# connect using wscat
wscat -c "wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1?token=<EPHEMERAL>"
```
ben_infra: Token rotation guidance: request new token every 45 minutes and reconnect gracefully to avoid in-stream swaps. We recommend ephemeral tokens for POC so you don't embed long-lived keys.
marta_prod: Pricing for sales: I'll propose two options in the doc: (A) Hosted pilot blended rate with usage cap; (B) Dedicated trial with a monthly commit estimate and expected unit cost. I'll include conversion paths and an optional discount for the 3-month timeframe.
devendra_se: Potential enterprise blocker: if Meridian must process PII on-prem, Private deployment timeline ~6-8 weeks. If thats not required, Hosted + BYOK + VPC egress should satisfy most compliance asks.
rachel_sdr: Ellie 1 can you provide SAML metadata and KMS intent? We plan a 2-hour POC demo next Wed 9am PST to walk through streaming function-calls, structured output, and security Q&A.
ellie_cust: Wed 9am PST works. I'll invite our infra lead.
ops_bot: Demo environment provisioned: demo-env-1716123456 1 creds will be DM'd to participants.
